extensionDescription.message: Save the current webpage, selected content, or a right-clicked image to your self-hosted EdgeEver instance.

popupDescription.message: Clip the current page or selection. Right-click selected text to save that passage, right-click an image to save it, or right-click a post on X to save that post.

diagnosticsDescription.message: View basic extension, browser, system, and connection information. API tokens are never included.

diagnosticsCopyFailed.message: Copy failed. Check the browser clipboard permission.

autoFirstNotebook.message: Use the first notebook automatically after connecting

missingSettingsDetails.message: Enter the EdgeEver instance URL and API token in the extension settings first.

instancePermissionRequired.message: Allow the extension to access your EdgeEver instance.

noAvailableNotebooks.message: No notebooks are available in EdgeEver.

currentPageNotFound.message: Could not find the current page.

captureTimeout.message: Page extraction did not finish within 15 seconds. The page may be large or still loading; refresh it and try again.

pageAccessDenied.message: The extension cannot read this page. Browser internal pages, extension stores, and restricted pages cannot be captured.

instanceNetworkFailed.message: Could not connect to the EdgeEver instance. Check the instance URL, network connection, and CORS settings.

emptyPageContent.message: (No readable content was found on this page)

selectionSaveHint.message: Select text on a page, right-click, and choose “Save selection to EdgeEver”. It is saved as a new note in the default notebook selected below.

selectionSaved.message: Saved the selection as a note.

selectionEmpty.message: No text was selected, so nothing was saved.

imageSaveHint.message: Right-click an image on a webpage and choose “Save image to EdgeEver”. It is saved as a new note in the default notebook selected below.

imageUnreadable.message: The image file could not be read, so nothing was saved. It may be drawn by the page, or it may require a signed-in download.

imageTooLarge.message: This image is larger than 20 MB, so it was not saved.

imageUnsupportedType.message: This image format cannot be saved into a note yet. PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, and AVIF are supported.

imagePermissionIntro.message: This page cannot read the image file. After you allow the site that hosts it, EdgeEver saves it as a new note in the clipper's default notebook. Only the image you chose is read.

imagePermissionToast.message: Allow access to this image's site to save it.

allowAllSitesAndSave.message: Allow all sites, then save future images directly

imagePermissionDenied.message: Site access was not allowed, so the image was not saved.

imageResourceScopeRequired.message: This API token cannot write attachments. Create a full-access token in EdgeEver settings.

imageSaveExpired.message: This save has expired. Right-click the image and try again.

tweetSaveHint.message: On X, right-click a post and choose “Save this post to EdgeEver”. The post text, including text behind Show more, and the photos go into one new note in the same default notebook.

tweetSaved.message: Saved this post as a note.

tweetNotFound.message: Could not find that post. Right-click directly on the post.

tweetPermissionIntro.message: A timeline has many posts. Allow access to X so the clipper can remember the post under the pointer. After that, right-click the same post once more. Only the post you choose is saved to the clipper's default notebook.

tweetPermissionToast.message: Allow access to X to choose a post on the timeline. Then right-click that post again.

tweetRightClickAgain.message: Posts on the timeline can be recognized now. Right-click that post again.

tweetPermissionDenied.message: Access was not allowed. Right-click the post again to retry.

tweetPermissionReady.message: Access allowed. Go back and right-click that post again.
